I had a very disappointing experience at this clinic.

My mother came here for scaling (2,500 THB) and AirFlow cleaning (1,500 THB), which was recommended by the clinic after the initial examination. However, during the procedure, she developed bleeding and blood blisters on the roof of her mouth. The treatment had to be stopped before the AirFlow procedure was completed.

What disappointed me most was not only the injury, but also the communication afterward. Different staff members gave different explanations, and we never received a clear explanation of how the blood blisters occurred. We also disagreed with their assessment that the scaling had been fully completed, because there were still visible deposits on the teeth after the procedure.

In the end, the clinic only offered a partial refund for the unfinished AirFlow treatment, but the pricing explanation was confusing and we could not understand how the final amount was calculated.

I understand that bleeding can happen during scaling, especially in patients with significant tartar buildup. However, I expected clearer communication, more careful handling, and greater transparency when a complication occurred.

Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this clinic.
